build_SelfAttention: build a multi-head self attention module with QKV projection and optional QK normalization
build_SelfAttentionBlock: build a transformer block with pre-normalization, self attention, MLP, and stochastic depth
run_SelfAttention_forward: run the self attention forward pass on token embeddings with an optional attention mask
run_SelfAttentionBlock_forward: run the transformer block forward pass combining attention and MLP with residual connections
review_SelfAttention_qk_norm: review the SelfAttention class to understand how QK normalization is applied to query and key vectors
